Group rides in Florida

37 recurring group rides around Florida: 22 road, 13 social, 3 gravel. 14 roll on weeknights, 16 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Caloosa Riders Sunday Welcome Ride in Fort Myers — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Naples Velo Saturday Ft. Myers Bridge Ride runs black group 30+ mph in places; Blue group 24–27 mph; rotating paceline.
